candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to only check IERC1155 (removing IERC1155MetadataURI) so querying for IERC1155MetadataURI returns false while originally true.
Change the zero-address check to allow zero address and return stored balance (removes revert on zero address).
Invert the account zero check so that zero address always returns zero instead of stored value.
Return double the stored balance (observable change) instead of the stored balance.
Always return stored balance plus one (off-by-one) instead of the stored balance.
Remove the require that account is not zero, replacing it with a check that returns 0 for the zero address instead of reverting (changes observable balanceOf for address(0)).

Change the loop to iterate using a signed int and allow negative wrap, causing different indexing behavior when accounts.length is large (underflow risk) — replaces the for-loop header to use int256 and decrement, altering returned balances for some inputs.
Replace the per-iteration assignment to set batchBalances[i] to zero before calling balanceOf, causing returned balances always to be zero.
Assign balances from the wrong mapping index: use ids[0] for every entry so all returned balances equal balanceOf(account, ids[0]).
Change the length used to allocate result array to ids.length + 1, returning an extra zero entry and shifting indices when lengths match, causing different returned array shape/content.
